text:
Alex K: Customer on a locked retail kiosk (embedded webview) reporting intermittent 401s and we can't see any request IDs in the payload. They say the UI shows "Something went wrong" only.
Priya S: Sounds like a proxy or webview that strips headers. Can they run devtools?
Alex K: No, kiosk is locked down — only SSH to a management box. Customer says they can run a laptop on same subnet though.
Morgan (CS): Ok, minimal handoff we need: a) a curl from a laptop on the same network (curl -v) b) a screenshot of the kiosk admin test page/network if available c) app logs around the failed request (10–20 lines) d) any proxy/device syslogs.
Alex K: I'm going to paste a ready-to-run curl and a short checklist. Will ask them to replace placeholders.
Priya S: Good. Also ask them to add an explicit request id header on the client side so we can correlate if proxy rewrites headers. Example: `X-Request-ID: kiosk-<shortid>`
Alex K: Paste for customer:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <CUSTOMER_API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: kiosk-test-123" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
```
Alex K: Ask them to capture the full `-v` output (request+response headers and status). If response headers include `x-redwood-reqid` or `x-request-id` copy that.
Theo Eng: If the response has no req header, have them check server-side logs for `req_id=` or `request_id=`. Our runtime logs look like: `INFO inference request=req_id=abc123 model=gpt-4k latency_ms=120` — ask them to grep for `req_id=` around the timestamp.
Morgan (CS): If they cannot run curl, grab a HAR from their laptop (Chrome devtools) or use mitmproxy/Charles/Proxyman between kiosk and upstream. HAR should contain the outbound request and response with headers.
Priya S: For locked webviews: ask them to enable remote debugging (Android WebView: `adb forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_<pid>`) if they can get the management box to run it. If not possible, get a screenshot of the kiosk "test API" response and the management box network trace.
Alex K: Also offer a short repro payload to simplify: `{"input": "status-check"}` and tell them to run it 3 times and send the first and last response — helps detect intermittent gateway issues.
Morgan (CS): If proxy is suspected to rewrite headers, instruct them to set a custom header we look for: `X-Orig-Req: kiosk-test-123` and ask them to forward that. We can search logs for `X-Orig-Req=kiosk-test-123`.
Theo Eng: If they are able to upload a debug bundle, tell them how: run our debug-token flow in Console or run the SDK helper to generate a `debug_token` (we can also create one for them temporarily). The bundle should include the SDK request/response, environment, and a small log snippet.
Support Bot: Debug token created: dbg_kiosk_7f4d (expires in 24h) — please paste the token into the upload form or attach the bundle to this thread.
Alex K: If they send logs without req id: ask for timestamps in ISO format and the exact `-v` curl output; we can slice logs by time window.
Priya S: Example ask we can paste to customer (short):
```
Hi — to help us escalate we need:
1) Run from a laptop on the same network: the curl below (replace <CUSTOMER_API_KEY>) and paste the full `-v` output.
2) If possible add header `X-Request-ID: kiosk-<shortid>` when making the request.
3) If you can get a HAR or proxy capture, attach it. If not, screenshot the admin test response and provide management box network logs around the time.
4) If you can generate/upload a debug bundle or accept dbg_kiosk_7f4d, please do so.

Curl to run:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <CUSTOMER_API_KEY>" -H "X-Request-ID: kiosk-XYZ" -d '{"input":"status-check"}' https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
```
Morgan (CS): If they cannot share API keys, have them create a short-lived key with minimal scope or share an anonymized response (scrub tokens but keep headers). The request-id header can be a fake value we will search for.
Theo Eng: When we have either `x-redwood-reqid` from response or a client-supplied `X-Request-ID`, we can correlate with our backend traces; if proxy rewrote it, searching by timestamp and src IP usually finds it.
Alex K: I'll send the ask to the customer now. If they reply with output, I'll drop it into this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Support Bot: Note: If customer provides an HAR, please zip and redact any PII before upload.
